_note: A3: on-cost loading, so a client can see the fully-loaded rate behind every headline figure rather than take Atlas's word for it. These are Australian-context defaults (superannuation guarantee, leave loading, payroll tax, workers compensation) and are meant to be edited per engagement, not trusted as a universal rate.
_basis: Applied on top of whatever the ingested cost column holds. Atlas assumes that figure is base salary/wages unless the upload context states it is already fully loaded — in which case set every rate here to 0 rather than double-loading a number that already carries them.
